The Params and the save node are set up so that the meta data of everything pertaining to the image creation, model, loras, resolution, prompts, sampler & scheduler, seed and all that stuff is embedded inside the image.  If you post your image to CivitAI it will read that data and auto-populate the details.  

Which is nice.

nodes.title: delete me
widgets_values:
Ok so check it out.

To the right you will see, in the load image batch node, a box labeled "path".  This is the complete path to a folder containing a bunch of images you want to upscale.  

1. Paste the entire path into that box
2. Count up how many images are in the folder and set the Queue(the button you push to do things) to that number.
3. Make the "seed" box in the "Incrementer" node 0
4. Make sure the boolean switch is set to false

This will let you run through all the images in the folder and upscale them

IF: you want to do just one image, flip the boolean switch to true and use the image loader to load the image.

Good luck!
